d:
The hunt for Bigfoot continues with more unforgettable moments from Expedition Bigfoot. From unexplained sounds and reported sightings to strange clues deep in remote wilderness, the team investigates evidence that keeps the mystery alive. Each encounter brings new questions about what could be hiding in the forests.
Can the team uncover convincing evidence of Bigfoot, or will the wilderness keep its secrets?
Watch Expedition Bigfoot, Season 1, Episodes 3, 6 and 7 Season 2, Episodes 9, 12 and 4 and Season 3, Episodes 9, 3 and 5, on Discovery Channel India.
